$comment: Which schema version each consumer is pinned to. content/schemas ships more than one version of several schemas; without this map a validator cannot tell a current schema from a retired one, and can bless content the engine no longer loads. Retired schemas move to content/schemas/retired/ and are kept solely so SaveMigrator can reason about old saves.

dungeon-definition.notes: v2 adds roomContent/locks/puzzles and generatorCapabilities. v1 predates the room-content pass and no longer matches serializer output. See docs/ADR/0002-procgen-authority-split.md.

character-state.notes: The runtime schemaVersion integer is NOT this file's v1/v2 label — it is pinned in content/fixtures/schema_versions.json and asserted by scripts/validate-content/validate.mjs's validateSchemaVersionParity() (SY-12 — the ClientVersionParityTests suite this note used to name was removed; see CORE_GAMEPLAY_REVIEW.md §119).
